proposals.text:
Thanks — I can proceed with an account lookup and verification, but our lookup tools only support searching by one of these: full name (case-sensitive as on the account), Rho‑Bank user ID, or email address. I don’t have a tool to look up accounts by phone number.

Options:
- If you can provide your Rho‑Bank user ID or the email address on file now, I can proceed with the verification using the two fields you already gave (DOB 11/03/1990 and phone 312-555-0481).
- If you can retrieve the exact case-sensitive full name on the account, I can use that instead.
- If you prefer not to provide any of those here, you can call 1-800-RHO-BANK or use secure chat in the mobile app to complete verification and an agent can investigate; I can walk you through what they’ll need.

Which would you like to do? If you provide a user ID or email (or the exact account name), I’ll look you up and then log the verification timestamp as the next step.
